headline_ne: बेलायतको विद्यार्थी भिसा अस्वीकृति दर एक दशकयताकै उच्च
headline_en: UK student visa refusal rate highest in a decade
points_ne: बेलायतको प्रायोजित विद्यार्थी भिसा अस्वीकृति दर ६.४ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ।
सन् २०२६ सेप्टेम्बरसम्मको एक वर्षको तथ्यांक हो।
बेलायतको गृह मन्त्रालयले तथ्यांक सार्वजनिक गरेको हो।
points_en: UK sponsored student visa refusal rate has reached 6.4 percent.
The figure covers the year to September 2026.
The UK Home Office released the data.
Rate is at its highest point in a decade.
caption:
UK student visa refusals hit a ten-year high. 

The UK Home Office data shows the refusal rate for sponsored student visas rose to 6.4 percent in the year to September 2026. This is the highest level in a decade. 

बेलायतको गृह मन्त्रालयको तथ्यांकअनुसार सन् २०२६ सेप्टेम्बरसम्मको एक वर्षमा प्रायोजित विद्यार्थी भिसा अस्वीकृति दर ६.४ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ। यो एक दशकयताकै उच्च हो। 

Are you or someone you know planning to study in the UK? Tell us in the comments. 

Source: Ratopati
